description:
The shareholders in the Altitude Sickness lounge have been bored for eleven days, and Vane has watched what a bored shareholder does to a room.

So Vane has invented a bounty. There is a thing in the deep water off the bay. It has always been there. Nobody has ever needed it dealt with, and nobody needs it dealt with now.

"They'll pay," Vane says, polishing a glass that is clean. "They'll pay a great deal, and they will talk about it for a month, and they will be pleasant to the staff for at least a fortnight of that."

The glass goes back on the shelf.

"You should know it is not a problem anybody has. I would rather you knew."
name: Deep Pockets

objectives.desc: Kill the bay leviathan in the deep water (The Deep / The Wreck)
emotes: {who} goes out over deep water for the entertainment of people who will never see it.
{who} finds the leviathan, and understands immediately why nobody has needed this done.
{who} kills a thing that was minding its own business in the only part of the bay nobody uses.
